realism.thirst.2: You're dizzy from thirst. Find water!
realism.thirst.3: You're collapsing from thirst. DRINK NOW!
realism.sleep.2: You're nodding off. You need to sleep.
realism.sleep.3: You're hearing things that aren't there... SLEEP!
realism.sleep.rested: You slept well and feel rested.
realism.stamina.breathing: You're out of breath. Stop and rest.
realism.stamina.shaky: Your legs are shaking. Rest or you'll pass out!
realism.tear: Ouch! You tore a muscle in your arm. Slow down.
realism.tear.bad: You tore it again, badly. That needs a doctor.
realism.leg.rock: CRACK! You landed on rock and badly broke your leg.
realism.burn.1: Ow! 1st degree burn. Don't touch a working furnace!
realism.burn.2: 2nd degree burn! Blisters on your hand.
realism.burn.3: 3rd degree burn! That needs a hospital.
realism.frostbite: Frostbite! Your fingers and toes are freezing. Get warm!
realism.bleed.1: You're bleeding a little. It should stop on its own.
realism.bleed.2: You're bleeding heavily! Use a bandage.
realism.bleed.3: SEVERE bleeding! Put a tourniquet on NOW!
realism.bandage.too_much: Too much bleeding for a bandage. Use a tourniquet!
realism.tourniquet.done: Tourniquet on. The bleeding is held, but you'll move slower.
realism.tourniquet.not_needed: A tourniquet is only for severe bleeding.
realism.syringe.too_little: Not enough blood to give right now.
realism.transfusion.full: There's no room for more blood.
realism.transfusion.reaction: Wrong blood type! %s doesn't match %s. You feel very sick.
item.realism.bandage.tip: Stops light and heavy bleeding. Use on yourself or a player.
item.realism.tourniquet.tip: Holds severe bleeding. You move slower while it's on.
item.realism.syringe.tip: Draws 0.5 l of blood into a blood bag (yourself or a player).
item.realism.blood_bag.tip: Gives 0.5 l of blood. The blood type must match!
realism.neck: CRACK! You broke your neck. Don't move much and get to a hospital for surgery!
realism.surgery.no_doctor: You need a Doctor nearby (a villager working at a Medical Station).
realism.surgery.done: Surgery done. You wake up groggy, but you're fixed up.
realism.cream.healed: The burn cream healed your burn.
realism.cream.helped: The burn cream soothes it. A 3rd degree burn still takes time (or surgery).
realism.splint.done: Splinted. Your leg will heal 3x faster.
realism.fiberglass.itch: Itchy! Don't touch fiberglass with bare hands.
realism.fiberglass.cough: *cough cough* Wear a helmet/mask when breaking fiberglass!
realism.mood.1: You're feeling down. Friends, pets, music or a good game might help.
realism.mood.2: You're feeling really low. Spend time with friends, rest, or see a Doctor for therapy. It gets better.
realism.console.fun: You played some games. That was fun!
realism.console.again: You just played. Give it a minute.
realism.tv.fun: You watched a show and laughed a lot.
realism.tv.again: You just watched something. Give it a minute.
realism.therapy.done: You talked things through with the Doctor and feel much lighter. (In real life too: talking to someone you trust really helps.)
item.realism.part.tip: Right-click a PC Case with it to install it.
realism.pc.no_power: No power! Give the PC Case a redstone signal (plug it in).
realism.pc.sag: ⚠ Your GPU is sagging! Install an Anti-Sag Bracket. (%s boots left before it cracks)
realism.pc.cracked: CRACK! Your GPU sagged so much it broke. Buy a new one (and a bracket!).
realism.pc.game: You played a game on your computer. Fun!
realism.datacenter.ate: The AI ate it. It wants MORE.
realism.datacenter.hungry: The AI only eats RAM, GPUs and CPUs. Lots of them.
realism.collapse.you: You collapsed. Someone has to save you, fast...
realism.collapse.other: %s COLLAPSED! Defibrillator (charge, clear, shock) or call an ambulance, quick!
realism.revived: You're back! Take it easy for a while.
realism.gone.spectator: You died for good. You can only watch now.
realism.gone.new_person: You died for good. You start over as a new person.
realism.defib.no_patient: Look at a collapsed player within 3 blocks.
realism.defib.order: Wrong order: charge, then clear, then shock.
realism.ambulance.no_hospital: No hospital found (place an Operating Table).
realism.ambulance.sent: The ambulance rushes %s to the hospital!
realism.ambulance.no_doctor: You're at the hospital, but there's no Doctor! Someone has to defib you.
realism.neck.paralysed: You broke your neck and can't move your body! Someone needs to get you to a surgeon.
